comment: Preset pattern adapted from ahacker-1/cre-acquisition-orchestrator config/workflows.json (Apache 2.0). requiredFacts is a reporting contract, not a gate: absent facts never block a run — they are omitted from every output (never estimated) and listed in the deal room notice.

workflows.name: Full Marketing Package
workflows.summary: The flagship run — every output except the PowerPoint OM (brokers already have one; principals can request it separately).

workflows.name: Investment Summary Only
workflows.summary: v0.1 pipeline proof — full depth, one output.

workflows.name: Quick Announce
workflows.summary: Get the listing in front of the network today: LinkedIn + email + 1-pager.

workflows.name: Web Presence
workflows.summary: The shareable link: property website + 1-pager to attach.

workflows.name: Internal Prep
workflows.summary: Before going to market: DD checklist + CRM record, nothing public.
